hints.title: Bitwise Prefix Tree Target Matching
hints.text: To maximize the bitwise result, each bit should ideally align with its opposite complement starting from the most significant position down to the least.

hints.title: Opposite Bit Preference Branching Invariant
hints.text: At bit position i, if a child representing 1 - bit exists, taking that branch sets bit i in the candidate result to one.

hints.title: Binary Trie Insertion and Query Procedure
hints.text: Construct a binary trie where each number is inserted as a 31-bit binary path from most significant to least significant bit. For every number, query the trie by greedily stepping along the opposite bit branch whenever present, otherwise following the matching bit. Return the maximum achieved value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(32 * N) time and O(32 * N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every pair directly takes O(N^2) time, which is too slow for arrays with up to 200,000 integers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A binary trie with 31 levels uses O(31 * N) space and evaluates queries in O(31 * N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize bitwise greedy optimization from most to least significant bit using a binary trie structure.
